//cache: No cacheDirectory: Nx 23 then keeps the cache in ~/.nx/<id>/, where <id> comes from the git
repository, so every worktree shares it. Setting cacheDirectory or NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY gives

//: Components release together from one branch and keep independent versions.
The current version is the last <project>/<version> tag, or package.json before the first release.
The conventionalCommits shorthand is not used: it also sets currentVersionResolver,
and setting both is an error.
preserveLocalDependencyProtocols keeps workspace:^, so pnpm writes the real range at publish time.

//preVersionCommand: Refuses a real release outside main before anything is versioned, committed, tagged, or pushed.
A pre-push hook cannot do this: nx pushes with --no-verify. Dry runs (NX_DRY_RUN=true) pass.

//: Release notes are GitHub Releases, one per component; no CHANGELOG.md is written.
workspaceChangelog must stay false: nx cannot create GitHub Releases for both kinds of changelog.
Run nx release on main with GH_TOKEN set (export GH_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)"). On Windows nx does not
find the gh login; the release then fails after the tag is pushed, and a rerun releases nothing.

//goToolchain: backend/.go-version belongs to no project, so the Go targets list it as an input. It is not in
sharedGlobals, which would rebuild every JavaScript project on a Go version change.

//outputs: nx-go declares dist/{projectRoot}*, which for agent also matches agents-backend's binary.
These name the one file the executor writes; .exe is the Windows name.
